# 💡 Star Key Selected Presentation
**concept** · shared · knowledge

September 7 design for an inspectable selection of VTA identity, relationships, knowledge pathways, agreements and artefacts. A presentation must bind its audience, purpose and verified claims; geometry and compression do not confer authority.
